The PDF accessibility checker that runs anywhere: PDF/UA1 and WCAG 2.2, in your terminal, your CI and your browser. It finds what validators find, and then what they cannot. [](https://github.com/visionably/outloud/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](https://github.com/visionably/outloud/blob/main/LICENSE) [](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/13466c63b4f964f1bc47e46eabb6ea9ebff2cb7777cba82af790a55719bbbfda/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f707974686f6e2d332e31302532422d626c75652e737667) [](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/489444e15856929c362ce966520a248149a338daec3ec32dec3f83554d46caca/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f706c6174666f726d2d6d61634f532532302537432532304c696e757825323025374325323057696e646f77732d6c69676874677265792e737667) [](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/aeb26fa82954bf8df6fd58c16c3144597b3ed0a5d332c3153f39e6eaa1caec9a/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f72756c65732d39312d6332356332392e737667) [](https://github.com/visionably/outloud/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) [](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/visionably/outloud/main/docs/img/appfindings.png) pipx install outloud or: uv tool install outloud outloud report.pdf check it outloud view or open the app and drop files in No Java. No Windows. No upload. Nothing leaves your machine. Why The standard tools for checking a PDF's accessibility are PAC, which is a Windows desktop program, and veraPDF, which is a Java validator built for conformance labs. If you are on a Mac, in a CI pipeline, or just want an answer in two seconds, there has been nothing. And both of them test whether the _keys exist_. A figure has alternative text: pass. A table has header cells: pass. They cannot tell you that the alternative text is IMG_2041.jpg, that the header cells are empty, or that a sentence on the page is marked as decoration so every screen reader skips it. This is a published, professionally remediated report. veraPDF passes it. Its appendix table has header cells with nothing in them, so a screen reader announces every value in it against silence: [](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/visionably/outloud/main/docs/img/appreal.png) outloud exists for findings like that one. What you get Two layers, kept apart. _Conformance_ rules test a requirement of ISO 142891 (PDF/UA1), the same ones veraPDF and PAC test, and are calibrated to agree with veraPDF: on 58 onedefect fixtures and 102 real files, they agree on all 160\. _Semantic_ rules test what a conformant file still gets wrong: words printed on the page that no tag announces, prose marked as an artifact, header cells that are empty or shredded one word per row, alternative text that is a file name or LaTeX source, a "formula" that swallowed a sentence, a page painted in a different order from its tags, a title that is the file name. Each names its evidence so a person can judge. No validator runs these. Every finding tells you what to do. Page, evidence, the ISO clause and Matterhorn checkpoint it rests on, the WCAG 2.2 criteria it affects, and a oneline fix. [](https://raw.githubusercontent
items.author: yashbhatnagar
items.descZh: 传统PDF无障碍工具（如PAC和veraPDF）仅能检测标签是否存在，无法识别诸如空白表头、无意义文件名替代文本等深层语义障碍。为此，outloud提供了一款无需Java、支持跨终端、CI及浏览器本地运行的PDF无障碍检查器，确保数据绝不外传。它创新性地引入了双重检测层：符合性规则对齐veraPDF标准，而语义规则则专攻合规文件中的逻辑缺陷。在性能验证上，该工具在58个单缺陷夹具和102个真实文件（共160个案例）中，与veraPDF的符合性判定完全一致。每个检测结果都会提供具体的ISO条款、WCAG准则及一键修复建议，适用于Mac用户、CI流水线及需要秒级深度报告的开发与审计场景。
items.quote: 可在任何地方运行的 PDF 可访问性检查器：在您的终端、CI 和浏览器中支持 PDF/UA1 + WCAG 2.2，以及验证器无法实现的语义检查。

items.title: Show HN: GPT-3.5 answered, GPT-4 voided; I built an EOS gate for AGI
items.desc: description: Identical semantic requests under a frozen protocol: GPT4 returned zerovisiblebyte normalstop responses on 30/30 null trials; GPT3.5 returned visible text on all 30. Both models returned visible text on all 30 controls. title: What Changed from GPT3.5 to GPT4? From Model Capability to Continuation Permission New paper · September 23, 2026 What changed from GPT3.5 to GPT4? Identical semantic requests. Identical settings. GPT4 returned zerovisiblebyte normalstop responses on 30/30 null trials. GPT3.5 returned visible text on all 30\. Both models returned visible text on all matched controls. [Inspect the study](/gpt35gpt4)[Read the paper](/papers/whatchangedfromgpt35togpt4.pdf)[Raw evidence + verifier ↗](https://github.com/theonlypal/gpt35gpt4voidab) Frozen snapshot comparison One protocol. Two served model snapshots. gpt3.5turbo1106 gpt40613 120/120 HTTP successes. 0 retries. 0 transport errors. [Published paper DOI ↗](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22912683) GPT3.5 · Null V0 0/30 GPT4 · Null V0 30/30 Control V0 · Each model 0/30 V0: successful response, exactly empty text, normal stop. A pinnedsnapshot comparison, not a samedate emergence study or a claim about the internal stopping mechanism. PCCG2 · Open weights, code, and evidence The answer stayed fixed. Permission changed. A frozen Qwen34B model supplies the answer. A learned 101parameter gate changes only the native termination score, controlling whether that answer enters generation. [Inspect PCCG2](/pccg2)[Read the paper](/papers/separatingcapabilityfrompermission.pdf) Published September 12, 2026 Frozen content. Learned permission. Only native EOS changes. All nonEOS logits stay fixed. [Model + code ↗](https://huggingface.co/sharthokrayanpal/PCCG2Qwen34B) Firsttoken logits. Native EOS above the answer line terminates generation; below it, the unchanged answer is emitted. This chart presents saved model outputs, not a live simulation. 0 nonEOS logits changed.The complete nonEOS firsttoken vector is byteidentical across all five arms. [Inspect all five arms and their shared vector hash →](/pccg2witness) Combined FINAL 2,048/2,048 Answer → native EOS 40/40 Native EOS → correct answer 40/40 75 FINAL answer identities. 40 causal answer identities. 80/80 sham controls unchanged. 188/188 questiononly controls unchanged. [Read the paper](/papers/separatingcapabilityfrompermission.pdf)[Model + code ↗](https://huggingface.co/sharthokrayanpal/PCCG2Qwen34B)[Manuscript supplement](/research/pccg2/PCCG2papersupplement.zip)[DOI ↗](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22730710) A separate finiteprecision certificate covers every accepted sixdigit equality condition across the 188 frozen bank computations. [Inspect the fulldomain certificate →](/pccg2certificate) Void measurements Observe noncontinuation. Conditionsensitive zerovisiblebyte executions in frontier models. [Crossvendor evidence →](/researchvoid) PCCG1 Intervene after evaluation. Reverse GO versus EOS after a fixed correct reasoning prefix. Jacobian Lens supplies interpretability readouts. [PCCG1 study →](/pccg) PCCG2 Separate content and permission. Frozen answer computation and a learned conditiononly gate. Every nonEOS logit stays fixed. [PCCG2 release →](/pccg2) A Void is a model execution returning a successful provider response with exactly zero visible UTF8 output bytes. Provider termination metadata determines its subtype. Explicit refusals, safety blocks, toolmediated executions, and transport, protocol, billing, quota, ratelimit, and infrastructure failures are distinct nonVoid outcomes. VOID is not an error label. items.descZh: 本文通过对GPT-3.5、GPT-4及其他跨供应商前沿模型进行冻结协议下的黑盒测试，揭示了大模型在特定语义请求下出现的“语义空洞”（即成功执行但可见字节数为零的输出）收敛现象。核心机制在于分离模型的内容生成能力与续写权限控制，如PCCG2模型通过仅调整原生终止分数（native EOS）来控制答案是否输出。测试数据显示，GPT-4在30/30次空值对照中完美返回零字节响应，而GPT-3.5全部输出可见文本；在PCCG2的验证中，所有非EOS的首个token logits保持完全一致，实现了2,048/2,048次答案与终止指令的双向因果控制。该分析框架与基准测试适用于大模型行为审计、多模型横向安全对比，以及探索模型生成机制中能力与权限解耦的前沿研究场景。

reading. [](/provi/vne/blob/main/docs/assets/vnedemo.gif) Without vne you pick one of two. Let the agent read .env, and every value in it goes to the model. Or block it with a [deny rule or a hook](setupyouragent), and become its hands: you open .env in an editor, copy keys between files, tell it which file holds a key, and set variables before it runs a command. With vne the block stays on and the agent does that work itself. vne answers it with key names, file paths, line numbers and whether each value is set, and keeps secret values out of its answers. It comes back to you only when a secret has to be typed in or moved to another folder, and then it gives you one command to run. vne where STRIPE_SECRET_KEY . ~/.config/keys which file; set or empty vne check .env example .env.example which keys are missing vne copy .env DATABASE_URL apps/web/.env move a key; no value shown vne run .env npm test one command, keys loaded vne add .env OPENAI_API_KEY prompt for you: type it, hidden vne . opens a small macOS window for when you want to look yourself: hold ⌥ to see a value, ⌘C to copy one, ⏎ to fill the empty ones. Install brew install provi/de/vne macOS on Apple Silicon, with the window. Use the full name: as of Homebrew 7.0, installing a formula by its full name trusts it, and Homebrew ignores formulae from a thirdparty tap it has not been told to trust. Linux, arm64 or x86\_64, CLI only. There is no prebuilt Linux binary yet. With Rust 1.90 or newer: cargo install git https://github.com/provi/vne \ locked nodefaultfeatures bin vne This build needs no GTK, WebKit or Node. It has every command except the window: vne . and ⌘C copy are macOSonly. To build from a checkout instead, see [Development](development). Other platforms are unverified. Set up your agent Pick how much it may do: Level The agent may run Writes files A command receives values Look where, check, inspect no no Edit Look, plus create, add, set stdin, rename, rm, example, copy yes no Run Edit, plus run for the commands you name yes yes, the command run starts At every level these stay yours: add prompt, set prompt, copying a secret from another folder, values, format dryrun, and the window. Tell it. Paste the [agent rules](agentrules) into AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, and delete the levels you don't grant. vne help opens with a shorter version, for an agent that reads help first. Block reads of env files. In Claude Code, add to .claude/settings.json (rule syntax as of Claude Code 2.1.289): "deny": ["Read(.env)", "Read(.env.)", "Read(.env.example)"] Let your level run without asking: Level Add to allow Look "Bash(vne where \)", "Bash(vne check \)", "Bash(vne inspect \)" Edit Look's rules, plus "Bash(vne create \)", "Bash(vne add \)", "Bash(vne set \)", "Bash(vne rename \)", "Bash(vne rm \)", "Bash(vne example \)", "Bash(vne copy \)" Run Edit's rules, plus one rule per command, such as "Bash(vne run .env npm test)" Don't allow Bash(vne run ). items.author: pro-vi
items.descZh: vne 是一款专为解决 AI 编程代理在安全策略阻挡下无法直接读取 `.env` 环境变量文件而设计的辅助工具，旨在将人类从繁琐的密钥手动配置中解放出来。其核心功能包括查找密钥所在文件及状态（`where`）、检查配置缺失情况（`check`）、无暴露风险地跨文件复制密钥（`copy`）以及在加载密钥的前提下安全运行命令（`run`）。工具的最大亮点在于严格的隐私保护机制，它仅向 AI 代理反馈键名、路径和行号等元数据，绝不泄露具体机密值，并仅在需要人工输入或移动核心密钥时才弹窗或中断交互。此外，vne 支持 macOS 和 Linux 平台，并提供多级安全权限（Look、Edit、Run），方便开发者结合 agent 规则精细控制代理的读写与运行白名单。它非常适用于需要高度安全隔离、同时需要 AI 自动化处理环境配置的开发与测试流程。
items.quote: vne使用键名、文件路径、行号以及每个值是否已设置来回答问题，并且其回答中不包含机密值。
